cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: 170s direct-response VSL for Motilli Celery Juice Gummies — exact framework port of the scaling Sculptique 'Gut Health 24/7' ad (207 ads live). Beat order mirrors the reference 1:1: call-out hook ('If your weight loss shots completely paralyzed your digestion...') -> product tease -> $-ding cost stack (MiraLAX, softeners/prune/tea, enema kits, prescription = $150) -> mechanism reveal (made for a NORMAL system; the shot stalls the engine at the TOP; every fix works at the BOTTOM, six feet downstream) -> three fixes (motility / enzyme / lining SUPPORT) -> honest results (week one nothing, day ten, two months clockwork) -> $150 loss frame, offer, 30-day guarantee. ONE continuous VO. New visual every 2-3s, hard cuts only. Modes: [UGC] live creator (same woman, late 50s, every shot), [ANIM] stylized medical animation, [PROD] product.

cards.title: OUR VERSION — MOTILLI (58 shots, 2-3s cadence, reference framework)

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: DO
cards.text: Hard cut every 2-3 seconds, no transitions. One creator, same woman, every UGC beat. ONE continuous VO over the assembled cut. Burned word-synced captions. Ding SFX per $ item and per checkbox; whoosh on TOP/BOTTOM stamps. Product: SQUARE clear jar, white cap, green label; gummies HEART-shaped dark matte green. Grade: muted-cool through the problem half, warm after 1:32.

cards.title: DON'T
cards.text: NO round jar, no gummy-bear shapes. NO '90-day guarantee' anywhere — guarantee is 30 days ('ninety day' = the pack name only). NO brand text on the injector pen; competitor bottles stay generic/unreadable. NO dependency/damage claims about laxatives or enemas — everything is her lived experience. NO named enzyme or lining ingredient, no doses, no 'clinical' — 'support' language only. NO doctor actor. NO overnight-results claim — week one is a miss on purpose. NO celebration beats.

cards.title: VO / AUDIO
cards.text: Voice: woman late 50s, plain, direct, a little wry. She says 'they' about Motilli, never 'we'. Pronounce 'MEER-uh-lax' (Seedance garbled it to 'Miranax' on MOT-Bloom — phonetic respell in any dialogue pass + Scribe QA on the render). Music low and patient until the 1:26 title card, opens up after the product reveal.

cards.title: FRAMEWORK MAP
cards.text: Reference beat order preserved 1:1. Swaps, hard-law only: fiber-gummy rung -> enema-kit rung (we ARE fiber gummies); doctor talking-head -> pharmacy bag; 'engine at the bottom of your stomach' -> 'engine at the very top of your system' (canonical spatial frame); named ingredients+doses -> 3x 'support' pillars (label carriers for pillars 2-3 unconfirmed); 'first morning I went' -> 'week one nothing, day ten' (never-overnight + honest timeline); 60% off/B2G1/60-day -> [OFFER] + 90-day reset pack + 30-day guarantee, opened bottle.

Reference product-reveal lighting: dark surface, warm golden key. Steal for our 1:32 reveal.
